**Who must sign this, in what order, and where exactly is it stuck?**


> Moving a decision through the people who are allowed to make it. The work is routing against real authority rather than against the org chart, sequencing approvers so a rejection at the end does not waste the queue, and knowing the difference between an approval that is pending and one that is stuck. Most administrative delay is one unchased approver.
